response.sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_usage) AS base FROM station_avg) SELECT AVG(s.avg_usage) AS mean_of_above_baseline_station_avgs, AVG(s.avg_usage - b.base) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE s.avg_usage > b.base

assumptions.assumption: Stations are taken from the telescopes table (grouped by observstation). Stations with no telescopes, or whose telescopes all have NULL bandusagepct, have no average and are left out of the baseline.
The baseline is the unweighted mean of the per-station averages, so each station counts once regardless of how many telescopes it has. Stations exactly equal to the baseline are not 'above' it.
